name: Gravity Choir
introDiscord:
Music changes gravity.

High notes send stones upward.

Low notes slam them down.

Shizuki's handwriting begins several feet above the floor and ends on
the ceiling.
introTwitch:
Music changes gravity.

High notes send stones upward.

Low notes slam them down.

Shizuki's handwriting begins several feet above the floor and ends on
the ceiling.

gravity-choir-approach.prompt: Three impossible routes open across Gravity Choir.

left.message: A gentle note makes you almost weightless and eases your wounds.
left.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

right.message:
A Gravity Choir Siren sings.

The floor immediately becomes a wall.

forward.message: A cache hangs motionless in midwater.

gravity-choir-depths.prompt: Deeper within Gravity Choir, three paths bend through the unstable Nexus.

left.message:
One Berry is stuck to the ceiling.

Shizuki wrote below:

'Berry escaped due to soprano.

Recovery pending.'

right.message: Star Candies orbit a floating stone.

gravity-choir-threshold.prompt: Near Mass-Song Amphitheater, three final routes cross the edge of reality.

left.message: A Gravity Choir Siren drops you upward.

right.message: A perfect chord restores normal gravity and your strength.
right.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

forward.message: A coffer lands gently after a final note.

boss-antechamber.name: Mass-Song Amphitheater
boss-antechamber.prompt: Mass-Song Amphitheater begins singing without musicians.

bossPromptDiscord:
Mass-Song Amphitheater begins singing without musicians.

Everything starts falling toward the center.

Use /yes to enter or /no to maintain a traditional
relationship with downward.
bossPromptTwitch:
Mass-Song Amphitheater begins singing without musicians.

Everything starts falling toward the center.

Use !yes to enter or !no to maintain a traditional
relationship with downward.
bossRetreatText: You withdraw from Mass-Song Amphitheater. The impossible guardian will wait.

boss.revealText:
A dark point forms inside the song.

Singularity Cantor reveals itself!

completionText:
Gravity returns.

The Berry on the ceiling finally falls.

Mystery resolved.
